facts.fact: The operator dates construction of Van Mieu to 1070 and establishment of Quoc Tu Giam to 1076, as separate milestones.
facts.excerpt: 1070: King Ly Thanh Tong ordered the construction of Van Mieu; 1076: King Ly Nhan Tong established Quoc Tu Giam.
facts.location: Official Site History timeline, Ly and Le So dynasties

facts.fact: The timeline places an order for doctoral stelae under Le Thanh Tong in 1484.
facts.excerpt: 1484: King Le Thanh Tong ordered the erection of the Doctoral Steles.
facts.location: Official Site History timeline, Ly and Le So dynasties

notes: Source read for both localizations. Route order, suggested duration, pacing and packing are editorial advice. No price, guaranteed opening, guaranteed weather or search-volume claim. The operator historical timeline distinguishes Van Mieu (1070) from Quoc Tu Giam (1076); the compressed tourism overview is not used for these dates.
